cSAR projections for COA

Initializations

Packages

#install.packages("pak")
#pak::pak("lillyschwietzer/csarGeo-Package")
library("csarGeo")
library(terra)
library(readxl)
#install.packages("remotes")
#remotes::install_github("lillyschwietzer/csarGeo-Package")

Data

lu1995

class       : SpatRaster 
size        : 4803, 2623, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
resolution  : 20, 20  (x, y)
extent      : 62398.06, 114858.1, 65730.94, 161790.9  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
coord. ref. : ETRS89 / Portugal TM06 (EPSG:3763) 
source      : coa95_raster_20.tif 
name        : coa95_raster_20

Calibrating the projections

res <- countryside_sar(
  data = data,
  crs = 3763,
  method = "clusters",
  square_size = 2000,
  cluster_sizes = c(1,4,16,64,256),
  habitat = lu1995,
  habitat_names = c("Forest", "Agriculture", "Shrubland"),
  classification = classif
)

Visualization

visuals_sar(res, plot_type = "map")
